resources.string: Line drawings on a 24 unit grid, painted in code. Tap one for the name of its constant.
An icon fills the box it is given. The stroke is set apart from the size, so a large icon can stay light.
An icon takes the colour roles of text. Muted is the default. Tap a tone to set the large icon in it.
Chevrons and arrows to the left and right follow the reading direction. The check between them does not turn.
Six glyphs come from the original app: chevron, arrow, power ring, book, sliders and more. The other forty-four, the icon view, the tones and the mirroring were drawn and built for Mallet.
